text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's finally here, isn't it? The time to 
take in the view from the very top...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer! Stop spacing out and 
let's hurry over to the coaster!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, indeed. Who would've thought an 
amusement park had something so enticing?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
When you invited me out for 'the usual 
reward'... I wondered how you could be so 
carefree, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"—'Experience Japan's ultimate heights'— 
how could I ever ignore a pitch like 
that!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, follow me to the heights! ...Wait, 
what?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What's with that line... It can't 
be...!

The snaking line stretched all the way to 
the roller coaster entrance. And the wait 
time posted there was—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A-A two-hundred-minute wait...!? You've 
gotta be kidding me!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
We'd be standing the entire time, wouldn't 
we?! We came to relax, but that'll just 
exhaust us!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
B-But we came all this way... Ugh. What 
should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, everyone's lined up here. 
Everywhere else is probably completely 
empty.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, that settles it! If it's come to 
this, I'll just be number one at something 
else!

After that, I rode several attractions 
with Daiwa Scarlet...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Urrrgh... M-my head... is spinning. You... 
spun that teacup way too hard...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
T-True, our teacup was spinning more than 
anyone else's... but... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're trying so desperately, and your 
face is just... heheh! Jeez, now I feel 
like I'm gonna collapse from laughing.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still... with this, we've pretty much 
conquered all the 1st places!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Got the highest score at the shooting 
gallery, and set a new record on the 
go-karts! Now, next is...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...That sounds kinda really stupid. But 
well, I guess... you know.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...That was fun, wasn't it, Number 1?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
C-Come on! It's already night, so let's 
head home! We gotta give it our all again 
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm gonna savor first place in 
a race!

Together with Daiwa Scarlet, I enjoyed all 
sorts of "number ones."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ugh!! ...I give up...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: As if that could ever happen!!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fine! I'm aiming for first place with 
these legs of mine... Something like this 
is nothing!

And so, I ended up waiting in line with 
Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Miler... "er"... "er"...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, "ra" again!? Hey! How many times are 
you gonna end on "ra"!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez... we've been standing the whole 
time, and the shiritori turned into an 
endless slugfest... I'm exhausted, 
seriously.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
“Still... we're only halfway through the 
line. I'm not about to throw in the towel 
here.”

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Even in races, the middle leg is the 
critical moment!

We stayed in that long queue after that, 
and then, at long last...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
At last... we've fi-i-i-nally made it this 
far.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: We're up next... Trainer, are you ready!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! I was planning to do that even 
without you telling me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch! I'll definitely show you 
the best view in Japan on the turf as we—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Raaahaaaahhh~~~!!

Together with Daiwa Scarlet, I savored the 
heights of being "number one."
